name: dsh-oh-my-token
description: Native token admission for DeepSeek Harness: command-output filters, retrieval-style reads, a conservative prose trimmer, optional system-prompt editing, and a settings page that reports what was saved. No RTK binary, no codegraph server.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check bin/oh-my-token.js

meta.title: Oh My Token
meta.description: Compresses command output at the source, outlines large reads instead of pasting them, trims sentence-final periods from prose, and can append to or replace the system prompt. Every transform has a switch on one Settings page, which also reports what was saved.
